start.speaker: whisper
start.text: I ran a check on you. Old habit. Do you know what I found? Nothing. No handler, no recall code. You are just a person. I did not know I was allowed one of those.

choices.text: Whisper, I am ending this. I have to.

allowed.speaker: whisper
allowed.text: Allowed. Filed under things I will never say sober.

ended.speaker: whisper
ended.text: Ha. There it is. The recall. Fine. I have had cleaner extractions. Your back is still covered; that was never the deal.
